inputs.name: SqliteTableAdapter.constructor.db
inputs.description: A synchronous SQLite database handle used by the adapter's prepared statements. It must provide the prepare, all, get, and run calls used by the methods; the adapter does not open the database.

inputs.name: SqliteTableAdapter.constructor.model
inputs.description: Model metadata supplying the table, declared fields, and optional primary-key name used by the adapter. When primaryKey is absent the adapter uses id; an updatedAt field with default timestamp is refreshed during updates.

inputs.name: SqliteTableAdapter.find.id
inputs.description: The number or string compared with the configured primary-key column, which defaults to id. The method does not impose a narrower identifier format.

inputs.name: SqliteTableAdapter.findBy.fields
inputs.description: A field-to-value map converted by sqliteInput to build the WHERE clause. Null values become IS NULL checks, non-null values are bound, and an empty map selects without a WHERE clause.

inputs.name: SqliteTableAdapter.insert.input
inputs.description: A field-to-value map converted by sqliteInput before the INSERT statement is prepared. Values are bound through placeholders, while an empty map uses DEFAULT VALUES.

inputs.name: SqliteTableAdapter.update.id
inputs.description: The number or string compared with the configured primary-key column when selecting the row to update. When the input map is empty, this identifier is passed to find instead.

inputs.name: SqliteTableAdapter.update.input
inputs.description: A field-to-value map converted by sqliteInput for the UPDATE statement; an own property matching the primary key throws Error. An empty map returns find(id), and updatedAt is refreshed when its model default is timestamp.

inputs.name: SqliteTableAdapter.delete.id
inputs.description: The number or string compared with the configured primary-key column in the DELETE statement. The method reports whether any row was removed rather than returning the row.

outputs.name: SqliteTableAdapter.find
outputs.description: The first matching row mapped through sqliteRow, or null when no row matches. It finds that row using the model's primary-key field.

outputs.name: SqliteTableAdapter.findBy
outputs.description: An array of database rows mapped through sqliteRow. It is empty when no rows match, and an empty fields map requests all rows.

outputs.name: SqliteTableAdapter.insert
outputs.description: The inserted row mapped through sqliteRow from the result of INSERT ... RETURNING *. The declared result is T and the method has no null fallback.

outputs.name: SqliteTableAdapter.update
outputs.description: The updated row mapped through sqliteRow, or null when no row is returned. An empty input map instead returns the current result of find(id).

outputs.name: SqliteTableAdapter.delete
outputs.description: A boolean computed from whether DELETE reports a positive changes count. It is false when the database reports no rows removed.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: update throws this Error when the input has its own property matching the configured primary key. Its message is A SQLite primary key cannot be updated.
